quote: On May 19, 2025, H.E. Wei Hongtian, Ambassador of the People’s Republic of China to Grenada, H.E. Dame Cécile La Grenade, Governor General of Grenada, and Hon. Dickon Mitchell, Prime Minister of Grenada, jointly attended the completion and handover Ceremony of the Maurice Bishop International Airport Upgrade and Rehabilitation Project. He also expressed his gratitude to China Harbour for its hard work and dedication
note: Opened PRC Embassy Grenada English page 21 May 2025. CapEx blank on opened page.
